title: Area-weighted temporal skewness of optical pulses: inconclusive incremental respiratory-rate accuracy across two cohorts
abstract: Adding area-weighted temporal-skewness modulation of PPG pulses to five-modulation spectral pooling did not establish incremental respiratory-rate accuracy: equal-record MAE reductions were 0.1677 breaths/min (95% record-bootstrap CI -0.0541 to 0.4100) in BIDMC and 0.0991 (-0.1914 to 0.4803) in independent CapnoBase. Both intervals include zero; this does not establish equivalence or absence of respiratory information. Fixed unfitted algorithms on53 adult ICU and42 adult/pediatric perioperative records. Both datasets were previously exposed: exploratory external transport, not untouched confirmation. No clinical utility is established.
